editorial:
Imagine a world where a normal English family is anything but normal. You get dropped right into the messy lives of the Christies, where every day feels like a disaster waiting to happen. The vibe is weird, edgy, and kind of dark, using a unique animation style that makes everything feel a bit off-balance. You will see them deal with love and fights, but there is always a sense that something terrible is lurking just around the corner. It is not your typical family story; it feels more like a strange dream where the characters are trapped in their own bad habits and poor choices.

What really stands out is how the show doesn't hold back on the grit. The pacing is snappy, and the humor is dry and biting. While the animation might look a bit rough to some, it actually adds to the raw feeling of the story. If you like dark comedies that don't play by the rules, you will love this. You can find this as a digital rental on Apple TV or check for streaming options on Prime Video. If you are a collector who loves weird indie animation, grabbing a physical copy for your shelf is the way to go.
endingExplained: The story takes a sharp turn when the family drama reaches a breaking point. Instead of a happy ending, things spiral into legal chaos. You see the characters face the consequences of their actions as the law finally catches up with them. It all wraps up with a cold realization that they cannot escape their mistakes. The final scenes leave you with the chilling idea that they will be locked away for a very long time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and strange animation.
